captions.detailed: A compact roof-prism binocular made of dark matte plastic. It features two symmetrical optical barrels, a central bridge housing, and a narrow interpupillary hinge. The right eyepiece barrel is equipped with a distinct, slightly raised diopter adjustment ring, and a central focus wheel is integrated at the bridge joint. The interpupillary hinge, central focus wheel, and diopter ring are all designed to rotate relative to their parent components.
captions.instruction: Create a 3D model of a compact roof-prism binocular with a central bridge hinge. It should include two symmetrical optical barrels, a central focus wheel on a revolute joint, and a diopter adjustment ring on a revolute joint at the right eyepiece.
captions.factory: The code constructs an ArticulatedObject starting with a central bridge housing as the root part. It defines a central hinge joint (revolute) connecting the bridge to the left and right optical barrels. The barrels themselves are modeled using lofted or combined cylindrical primitives. Additional revolute joints are defined for the central focus wheel relative to the bridge, and for the diopter adjustment ring relative to the right eyepiece barrel.
